title: Modern Baseball Player Stats Dashboard
description: A responsive dashboard displaying baseball player statistics including batting average, home runs, RBIs, and recent game performance. Composed of a player profile card, a stats table, and a performance chart.

components.name: StatBadge
components.description: A small badge displaying a single statistic label and its value (e.g., AVG: .312).

value.description: Numeric or formatted value of the statistic

highlight.description: If true, renders badge with accent color to draw attention

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 text-white min-w-[80px]

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Circular player photo with a fallback initials placeholder.

initials.description: Two-letter initials shown when image is unavailable

layout.tailwind: rounded-full object-cover border-4 border-blue-500 shadow-lg w-24 h-24 md:w-32 md:h-32

components.name: PositionTag
components.description: Small pill tag indicating the player's field position (e.g., 'CF', '1B', 'SP').

layout.tailwind: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-600 text-white uppercase tracking-widest

components.name: SectionHeading
components.description: Section title with an optional accent underline, used to label each dashboard panel.

subtitle.description: Optional subtext displayed beneath the title

components.name: PlayerProfileCard
components.description: Card showing the player's photo, full name, team, position, jersey number, and key headline stats (AVG, HR, RBI).

stats.description: Key stats object: { avg: string, hr: number, rbi: number }

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center gap-4 p-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-900 to-slate-800 shadow-xl text-white w-full

components.name: StatsTableRow
components.description: A single row within the stats table showing one season or game-level stat line.

season.description: Year or label for the stat period (e.g., '2025', 'Career')

isHighlighted.description: If true, renders row with an accent background (e.g., current season)

components.name: StatsTable
components.description: Full responsive stats table with header columns and multiple season rows covering standard batting statistics.

rows.description: Array of stat row data objects

caption.description: Accessible caption for the table (e.g., 'Career Batting Statistics')

layout.tailwind: w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl bg-slate-800 shadow-lg p-4

components.name: GamePerformanceBar
components.description: A single vertical bar in the recent-game performance chart, representing one game's stat value (e.g., hits, HR).

maxValue.description: Maximum value in the dataset for relative height calculation

isSelected.description: Whether this bar is currently selected/hovered

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center justify-end gap-1 cursor-pointer group

components.name: ChartLegend
components.description: Color-coded legend for the performance chart indicating which color corresponds to which stat.

items.description: Array of { label: string, color: string } objects

components.name: PerformanceChart
components.description: Bar chart showing recent game performance over the last 10–15 games. Displays selectable stats (Hits, HR, RBI) with a legend and interactive tooltips.

games.description: Array of recent game data objects: { date, hits, homeRuns, rbi, opponent }

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col gap-4 p-6 rounded-2xl bg-slate-800 shadow-lg w-full

components.name: StatFilterToggle
components.description: Toggle button group allowing the user to switch the chart between Hits, Home Runs, and RBIs.

options.description: Array of { value: string, label: string } toggle options

layout.tailwind: flex flex-row gap-1 p-1 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 w-fit

interactions.action: Switches the active stat displayed in PerformanceChart

components.name: DashboardHeader
components.description: Top navigation bar showing the dashboard title, current date/season info, and an optional team logo.

teamLogoUrl.description: URL of the team logo image

layout.tailwind: flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 bg-slate-900 border-b border-slate-700 w-full

components.name: PlayerStatsDashboard
components.description: Full dashboard template composing the header, player profile card, stats table, and performance chart in a responsive grid layout.

player.description: Complete player data object consumed by child components

layout.tailwind: min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-white grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[320px_1fr] gap-6 p-6

components.name: PlayerStatsDashboardPage
components.description: Top-level page that fetches player data and passes it to the PlayerStatsDashboard template. Handles loading, error, and empty states with appropriate feedback UI.

playerId.description: Unique identifier for the player whose stats are displayed

breakpoints.notes: Profile card stacks above stats panel on mobile; side-by-side on lg and above.

interactions.action: Switches the active stat metric (Hits / HR / RBI) rendered in PerformanceChart and re-renders bar heights accordingly.
Displays a tooltip with full game details (date, opponent, stat value) and highlights the bar with an accent ring.
Applies a subtle background highlight to the hovered row for readability.
Marks the bar as selected and keeps the tooltip pinned until another bar is clicked or focus leaves.
Triggers data fetch for the given playerId. Renders skeleton loading placeholders inside PlayerProfileCard, StatsTable, and PerformanceChart while data is in-flight.

sidebar.description: Left column (320px fixed on lg+) containing PlayerProfileCard with photo, name, position, and headline stats.

main.description: Right column (flexible width on lg+) stacking StatsTable above PerformanceChart.

accessibilityNotes: All interactive elements (toggle buttons, chart bars) must be keyboard-focusable with visible focus rings.
StatsTable must use <table>, <thead>, <tbody>, <th scope='col'> and <th scope='row'> for proper screen-reader navigation.
Chart bars should expose aria-label with game date and value for non-visual access.
Color should never be the sole means of conveying information; pair with text labels or icons.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for all text against backgrounds.
Page should include a <title> and landmark roles: banner, main, region.
